note: Triennial election of the rural district council (ten electoral divisions), 1930: in nine divisions the person nominated was returned unopposed; Kernan was polled on 29 May 1930. Polled 29 May 1930. Gracey was the outgoing chairman of the council. John George Gracey: no party label printed in 1930. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Kernan, Armagh County Council, 29 May 1930, printed 'U': Belfast News-Letter, 30 April 1930, p. 15 ("Apathy in Rural Districts"); withdrawals from the Lurgan Mail, 10 May 1930, p. 4 ("No Contests in Armagh: County Council Nominees Withdraw"); Kernan, Armagh County Council, 25 May 1933, printed 'U': Lurgan Mail, 29 April 1933, p. 3 ("County and Rural Council Elections")).
